page_title: LIL 4-2 PAR | Lille v Paris FC 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 4 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Marius Broholm (Lille) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Kevin Trapp no chance!
90+6' Marius Broholm (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
90+5' Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) probably handled the ball. Lille are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
90+4' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) is booked for saying more than Benoit Millot was willing to tolerate.
90+3' Benoit Millot couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marius Broholm (Lille) and blew his whistle.
90+1' Moses Simon (Paris FC) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

88' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Berke Ozer anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
86' Here is a change. Aissa Mandi is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Ngoy (Lille).
86' It is time for a substitution. Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is on for Olivier Giroud.
86' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Paris FC players have a reason to celebrate!
85' The Paris FC players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
84' 3 - 2 Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
83' Here comes a substitution. Vincent Marchetti is given a rest as he is replaced by Lohann Doucet (Paris FC).
80' 3 - 1 Aissa Mandi (Lille) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.

79' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
79' The number of shots on goal at present is 8:2.
77' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Olivier Giroud (Lille) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Kevin Trapp no chance!
76' Olivier Giroud (Lille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

76' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Millot signals a foul. PENALTY to Lille! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
75' Olivier Giroud (Lille) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
74' Pierre Lees-Melou is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Alimani Gory (Paris FC).
73' Bruno Genesio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) replacing Nabil Bentaleb.
73' Marius Broholm (Lille) comes onto the pitch because Osame Sahraoui simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
70' The resulting set piece from Paris FC is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Berke Ozer.
67' Lille couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' The foul by Hamari Traore (Paris FC) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Millot.
66' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement. Lille win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
64' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
61' Chancel Mbemba (Lille) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the right post, but Kevin Trapp is alert and denies him.
61' Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) comes onto the pitch so that Hamza Igamane can be given a rest.
60' It's time for a substitution. Moses Simon (Paris FC) comes on in place of Mathieu Cafaro.
60' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) replaces Samir Chergui.
60' Here's the change. Willem Geubbels leaves the pitch and Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) comes on as a substitute.

59' Felix Correia (Lille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
58' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
57' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lille for a penalty. Play continues.
55' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
55' A quickly taken corner by Lille.

54' Hamza Igamane (Lille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Good work from Lille as they win a corner.
51' Romain Perraud (Lille) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle.
50' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Trapp comfortably gathers the ball.
48' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Hamza Igamane (Lille) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Kevin Trapp, who keeps it out.
44' Romain Perraud (Lille) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
43' The linesman raises his flag. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) is adjudged offside.
42' The ball is crossed into the box and Olivier Giroud (Lille) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp gets a glove on it to thwart him.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Great play by Romain Perraud releases Olivier Giroud (Lille) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 1:1.
38' Kevin Trapp is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Chancel Mbemba (Lille). Easy save!
33' Adama Camara (Paris FC) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
32' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Hamza Igamane (Lille) gets a yellow card.
29' Rough tackle by Hamza Igamane (Lille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
27' Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul after Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' A pass from Thomas Meunier (Lille) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
24' Hamza Igamane (Lille) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
23' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
22' Olivier Giroud (Lille) unleashes a shot, but it just misses the right-hand post.
21' Dangerous play by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille). Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Thomas Meunier (Lille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
17' Felix Correia (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Romain Perraud (Lille) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Lille earn a corner.
16' What a save from Kevin Trapp! Olivier Giroud (Lille) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' The resulting corner from Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is cleared by the defence.
14' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 0:1.
10' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

9' Great save! Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Berke Ozer. Paris FC will take a corner kick.
8' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
8' A cross into the box from Hamari Traore (Paris FC) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Paris FC are awarded a corner kick.
7' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
4' Felix Correia (Lille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
3' Hamza Igamane (Lille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benoit Millot no option but to blow his whistle.
2' Lille are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris FC will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Millot.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
